title: Frame
description: A player's mech: a full, standard SF2E PC (see common/sf2e-common.schema.json#/$defs/pcStatblock) — pick a class, build it exactly as any PC of the same level — reflavored at the fiction layer, plus Resonance-band gating and campaign repair-economy fields. Starts at level 12 and stays fixed there only through the six-day opening arc; from Day 7 onward it levels up in lockstep with its pilot's own milestone leveling (see design/campaign-arc.md's 8-level arc). At any level, abilityBands still controls which of the full statblock's feats/classFeatures/abilities/spellcasting/strikes are actually usable at the pilot's current Resonance band (see data/campaign/config.json resonance.bands) — leveling and band-gating are independent axes. One file per Frame in data/characters/frames/.

pilotKidRef.description: id of the kid who pilots this Frame.

level.description: 12 through the opening arc (Days 1-6); rises in lockstep with the pilot's kid level from Day 7 onward, gated by a major Claimant defeat plus enough downtime to refit. See design/campaign-arc.md.

concept.description: One or two sentence reflavoring concept (e.g. what a Strike/spell looks like at mech scale).

abilityBands.description: Which of this Frame's full level-12 statblock entries (from the pcStatblock fields above: feats, classFeatures, abilities, spellcasting.slots/focusSpells, strikes) are gated at each Resonance band. Each entry is a {refType, refName} pointer into this same file's arrays — refName should match that entry's "name" (or spell name / slot rank) exactly. A Dead Weight Frame should still be competent; sort generously rather than dumping everything into the top band.

internalPowerRoundsRemaining.description: Encounter-scoped tracker; clear between fights. Max value is set by the pilot's Resonance band (3-4/6/8/10 rounds).

refName.description: Must match the "name" (or spell name within spellcasting) of an entry elsewhere in this file.
